conclusions: The old 2-inch display axle has no substantiated strength basis. Screening stress changes strongly with both journal lever arm and diameter; do not promote it to a build dimension.
A nominal70mm bearing bore does not prove a70mm shaft or wheel seat is sufficient; journal and larger wheel-seat sections must be designed together.
Axle tilt relative to the guide frame needs an explicit angular-compliance path. A square vertical slide alone cannot be assumed compatible with rigidly aligned bearings and wheelset tilt.
Two same-envelope bearings have different catalog ratings. Do not substitute by boundary dimensions or add two single-bearing ratings to create a fictitious axlebox rating.
Basic bearing life arithmetic does not close rail suitability, actual loads, axlebox stiffness, setting or environmental reliability.
